title: A New Global Standard for Treating Heart Attacks in Women
subtitle: Leading medical groups have updated how heart attacks are defined to ensure women receive faster and more accurate care.

summary.en: Medical experts have announced the first universal definition for heart attacks to better support female patients. For decades, women often received less effective care because their specific heart attack types were ignored. The new guidelines change how doctors diagnose heart damage using blood tests. These updates focus on conditions that are more common in women, such as those linked to pregnancy and stress. This change is expected to improve survival rates and treatment quality for millions of people worldwide.
summary.zh: 醫學專家宣布了首個全球通用的心臟病發作定義，以更好地支持女性患者。數十年來，女性常因其特有的心臟病發作類型被忽視而獲得較無效的照護。新準則改變了醫師利用血液檢查診斷心臟損傷的方式。這些更新聚焦於女性較常見的病症，例如與懷孕及壓力相關的狀況。這項變革預計將提升全球數百萬人的存活率與治療品質。

paragraphs.en: Doctors around the world have reached a major agreement that will change how heart attacks are identified and treated. For the first time, there is a universal definition for a heart attack. This change is a significant step forward for millions of women who have historically received less effective care than men. Experts hope this new approach will end decades of women being treated as a lower priority in emergency rooms.
paragraphs.zh: 全球醫師達成了一項重大共識，將改變心臟病發作的識別與治療方式。這是史上首次針對心臟病發作建立全球通用的定義。這項變革對數百萬女性而言是一大進步，因為她們在過去所獲得的醫療照護往往不如男性有效。專家希望這項新方針能終結數十年來女性在急診室被視為次要優先順序的情況。

paragraphs.en: The landmark agreement was announced at a large heart health conference in Munich, hosted by the European Society of Cardiology. According to The Guardian Health, this is one of the biggest changes in medical procedure in a generation. Four of the world’s leading cardiovascular health groups worked together to create these new guidelines for doctors. The goal is to stop the dangerous delays that often happen when women arrive at hospitals with heart problems.
paragraphs.zh: 這項里程碑式的協議是在慕尼黑舉行的一場大型心臟健康會議上宣布的，該會議由歐洲心臟學會 (European Society of Cardiology) 主辦。根據《衛報健康版》報導，這是醫學程序在這一代中最重大的變革之一。全球四個領先的心血管健康組織共同制定了這些給醫師的新準則。其目標是杜絕女性因心臟問題抵達醫院時，經常發生的危險延誤。

paragraphs.en: Historically, medical systems focused heavily on heart attacks caused by a blood clot, which is the most common type in men. However, women often experience different types of heart attacks that do not involve a simple blockage. These conditions—such as coronary artery spasm, coronary embolism, and spontaneous coronary artery dissection (SCAD)—are much more common in women. SCAD, for example, involves a tear in the artery and happens in women at least 80% of the time, often during or after pregnancy. In the past, these cases were sometimes ignored or treated as less important, leading to worse health outcomes for female patients.
paragraphs.zh: 過去，醫療體系高度聚焦於由血栓引起的心臟病發作，這也是男性最常見的類型。然而，女性常經歷不同類型的心臟病發作，這些類型並不涉及單純的血管阻塞。這些病症，例如冠狀動脈痙攣、冠狀動脈栓塞以及自發性冠狀動脈剝離 (SCAD)，在女性身上更為常見。以自發性冠狀動脈剝離為例，這涉及動脈撕裂，且至少有百分之八十的病例發生在女性身上，通常是在懷孕期間或產後。過去，這些病例有時會被忽視或被認為較不重要，導致女性患者的健康預後較差。

paragraphs.en: Another major part of the new guidance involves how doctors use blood tests to diagnose heart damage. When the heart is injured, it releases a protein called troponin into the bloodstream. Previously, women were expected to meet the same troponin levels as men to get a diagnosis. Under the new rules, this threshold—the level required to confirm a medical issue—will be lowered for women. This change recognizes that women’s bodies may show signs of heart damage differently, allowing doctors to identify problems much sooner.
paragraphs.zh: 這項新指引的另一個重點在於醫師如何利用血液檢查來診斷心臟損傷。當心臟受損時，會釋放一種稱為肌鈣蛋白的蛋白質進入血液。先前，女性必須達到與男性相同的肌鈣蛋白數值才能獲得診斷。在新規定下，這項門檻（即確認醫療問題所需的數值）將為女性調降。這項改變承認女性身體顯示心臟損傷跡象的方式可能有所不同，使醫師能更早發現問題。

paragraphs.en: Prof. Bryan Williams, a leader at the British Heart Foundation, described the agreement as a “landmark moment.” He noted that for many years, women have missed out on accurate diagnoses because the medical community did not fully focus on the specific ways heart attacks affect them. By recognizing these less common causes, doctors can now offer treatments that target the actual source of the problem. This shift is expected to be life-changing for many women, as it helps patients understand their condition and what steps they should take next to recover.
paragraphs.zh: 英國心臟基金會 (British Heart Foundation) 的領導者布萊恩·威廉斯教授 (Prof. Bryan Williams) 將此協議形容為「里程碑時刻」。他指出，多年來，女性因醫學界未充分關注心臟病發作對她們的特定影響方式，而錯失了準確診斷。透過認可這些較不常見的成因，醫師現在能提供針對問題根源的治療。這項轉變預計將改變許多女性的生活，因為它能幫助患者了解自身狀況，並知道接下來該採取哪些步驟來康復。

paragraphs.en: This update follows a busy week of health news. Just a few days ago, researchers shared a large study showing that traditional exercises like Tai Chi can help people manage body pain. While that study focused on physical therapy and pain management, the new heart attack guidelines represent a more urgent change in emergency medicine. Both developments show a growing focus on using data to create better, more personalized care for all patients.
paragraphs.zh: 這項更新緊接在繁忙的健康新聞週之後。就在幾天前，研究人員分享了一項大型研究，顯示太極拳等傳統運動有助於人們管理身體疼痛。雖然該研究聚焦於物理治療與疼痛管理，但新的心臟病發作準則代表了急診醫學中更為迫切的變革。這兩項發展都顯示出醫學界日益重視利用數據，為所有患者創造更好、更個人化的照護。

paragraphs.en: Looking ahead, the new heart attack definition is expected to improve the speed and quality of care across the globe. By moving away from a “one-size-fits-all” approach, medical professionals can finally address the unique biological differences that have left women vulnerable for too long. Experts believe that these changes will reduce the number of missed diagnoses and ensure that women get the urgent, life-saving treatment they deserve.
paragraphs.zh: 展望未來，新的心臟病發作定義預計將提升全球醫療照護的速度與品質。透過擺脫「一體適用」的模式，醫療專業人員終於能處理那些長期讓女性處於弱勢的獨特生物學差異。專家相信，這些改變將減少誤診數量，並確保女性獲得她們應得的緊急救命治療。

keyTerms.definitionEn: To fail to get the benefits or opportunities that others have.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 錯失、沒能享受到（機會或好處）。
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見於日常對話，這裡指女性因醫療體系偏差而未能獲得正確診斷。文中：He noted that for many years, women have missed out on accurate diagnoses because the medical community did not fully focus on the specific ways heart attacks affect them.

keyTerms.definitionEn: A level or point at which something starts to happen or is considered to be true.
keyTerms.noteZh: 原意指門檻，這裡指醫療診斷的數值標準。文中：Under the new rules, this threshold—the level required to confirm a medical issue—will be lowered for women.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To deal with or pay attention to a problem or matter.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作名詞（地址）或動詞（致詞），這裡指解決醫療上的問題。文中：By moving away from a “one-size-fits-all” approach, medical professionals can finally address the unique biological differences that have left women vulnerable for too long.

quiz.question: What is one specific condition mentioned that causes heart attacks more frequently in women than in men?
quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第三段，SCAD（冠狀動脈剝離）在女性中發生的比例至少佔 80%，且常發生在懷孕期間或之後。選項 A 是男性心臟病發作最常見的原因；選項 C 的 troponin 是診斷指標而非心臟病發作的類型；選項 D 並未在文中被提及為導致女性心臟病的主要原因。

quiz.question: Why did the medical community previously struggle to diagnose heart attacks in women effectively?

options.A: Women were unwilling to go to emergency rooms for heart issues
options.B: Doctors lacked the necessary equipment to test for troponin
options.C: Medical standards were primarily based on symptoms and conditions common in men
options.D: There was no global agreement on how to treat heart attacks at all

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據文章第三段與第四段，過去的醫療系統過度關注男性常見的血栓問題，並對女性採用與男性相同的 troponin 檢測閾值，這顯示醫療標準長期以來是以男性生理為基準。選項 A 文中未提及；選項 B 錯誤，因為檢測設備存在，只是標準設定不當；選項 D 錯誤，因為過去有標準，只是不適用於女性。

quiz.question: In the fourth paragraph, what does the word 'threshold' mean in the context of the new heart attack guidelines?

options.A: A specific limit or level that triggers a diagnosis
options.B: The physical entrance to a hospital emergency room
options.C: The amount of pain a patient can endure
options.D: A type of protein found in the heart

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。文中提到「this threshold—the level required to confirm a medical issue」，明確定義了 threshold 指的是確認醫療問題所需的數值標準。選項 B 是該詞的字面意義，但在文中不適用；選項 C 與文中提到的 troponin 數值無關；選項 D 混淆了 threshold 與 troponin 的定義。

quiz.question: What is the primary purpose of the new heart attack guidelines described in the article?

options.A: To encourage women to exercise more like Tai Chi
options.B: To replace all existing heart surgery procedures
options.C: To standardize care and improve diagnostic accuracy for women
options.D: To reduce the number of heart health conferences in Europe

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。整篇文章的核心在於介紹一套新的心臟病診斷標準，旨在解決過去女性因生理差異被忽視或誤診的問題，從而提供更精準的醫療照護。選項 A 僅是文中提到的一個次要新聞；選項 B 過度誇大，文中並未說要取代所有手術；選項 D 與文章主旨完全無關。
